notes.title: Kickstarter Pre-Launch
notes.content:
[b]Hey everyone![/b] We are happy to announce that our [b]prelaunch campaign[/b] has now started! If you wish to support us, please feel free to[b] follow our campaign on Kickstarter![/b]

We aim to gain as many campaign followers as possible to help increase our Kickstarters success rate.

Please know we appreciate you all who have helped us, we are very excited to share with you all, our game and look forward to what comes next. ːsteamhappyː

Kickstarter Pre-Launch: [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/flibbles/flibbles?ref=clipboard-prelaunch]Click Here[/url]

Best,
Takeback Studios Team

notes.title: Demo Announcement
notes.content:
Hello Gamers!

It's our honor to announce to you the Flibbles Demo - Release Date 12/12/21!

We want to say thank you to all those who have supported us up to this point, we had to overcome some obstacles along our development journey. However, we never let hard times prevent us from reaching our goal. So once more thank you all, we hope you enjoy our demo! 

The Takeback Studios Team ːsteamhappyː
